MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable fits my TV and Blu-ray setup as a useful spare, and its longer length gives me more flexibility when placing equipment.",
    "The memory cards connect with my past interest in removable storage and card readers, though I would need a specific use and compatible device before choosing one."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming sticks duplicate what my existing Fire TV Stick 4K Max already does, so being related to my purchases does not give me a reason to buy them.",
    "The older Echo Dot and Echo Show feel like backward replacements for the newer versions I already have, especially after I added a stand for my second-generation Show.",
    "The older tablet and wired earbuds do not address an apparent need in the home electronics and computer equipment I have been using."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Alexa purchases seem to have been interpreted as wanting more Alexa devices, even when those devices repeat functions I already have.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been taken as interest in any electronic accessory, without enough attention to what it would help me do."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The versions I already own matter: an older or less capable device needs a clear additional purpose to interest me.",
    "Purchases such as my Echo Show stand and Harmony replacement batteries suggest that maintaining and supporting equipment I own can be more useful to me than buying another device.",
    "Storage capacity and compatibility matter more than simply recognizing that I have bought a memory card before."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my home electronics interests but miss my stronger need for useful additions to equipment I already own."
}
